authority.note: This file is the machine-readable form of the owner's authoritative score, not a competing plan. Where this file and Docs/Plans/POITOU_P0_GOLDEN_WALK_2026-10-21.md disagree, the document wins.

scope.route: Bedroom -> House -> Poitou village -> Canal landing -> departure / First Dream handoff
mandatory_player_verbs: inspect one bedroom focal point (companion/perch or meaningful object)
initiate one existing Quill choice at the approved existing NPC placement
scope.runtime_status: DESIGN CONTRACT. Every beat is PROPOSED until proved in the live editor. This file certifies nothing.

separates_from.rule: The experience P0 and the integration P0 are two different proofs. A green experience walk does not certify combat/save/packaged proof; a green integration map does not certify the experience. The First Dream golden-run integration P0 must remain intact and must not be replaced or silently rewritten with this scenic route.

hard_exclusions: no new combat, swimming, fishing, flight, traversal unlock, escort AI, second World Compiler, separate save authority, village economy, interiors for every home, or Sea Above assets
at most three mandatory player actions; normal traversal and door use do not count
no mandatory pixel-hunt, wait timer, or punitive rhythm fail - a failed resonance input invites a retry
no duplicate Morning maps - one canonical player route
scope.conflict_flag: L_MelusinaMorning was reduced to a 37 KB shell on 2026-10-21 and Poitou became the live level, while this route's house leg is authored against Morning ownership. The house leg needs an explicit live-audit decision before PASS B (see acceptance.not_yet_true).

meter.note: Single governing meter for the Poitou world. The earlier '2.4 m = allegro 3/4 / 3.6 m = andante 4/4' phrasing is superseded. Tempo authority of UMelodiaMusicClockSubsystem (global tempo, per-zone key) must be confirmed before authoring any tempo-locked clip.

readability_obligations: Camera releases control after a short playable intro and the skip path leaves no stuck cursor or input.
Melusina is grounded in one contained authored bedroom with one stained-glass window; light and hush read as a calm pastel dawn.
One strong visual line runs from bed to the focal point; other desk/window inspections stay optional.
The inspection fires exactly once and stays legible without UI spam.
A short musical motif suggests something missing without becoming a long expository cutscene.
Exactly one accepted event and one audiovisual response; a second activation does not duplicate state.
The response is forgiving and accessible - failure invites a retry, it never punishes.
The bedroom door opens onto the larger house with correct collision, spawn, facing and input returned.
No duplicated pawn; the map split is decided only after a live audit.
One curved landing and one oval salon; the grand staircase is framed without requiring the player to go upstairs.
House identity is clear with FX disabled; no snagged furniture or stair collision on the route.
No black-void or frame pop on the exterior reveal; normal control returns; the toon/watercolor treatment stays stable.
Three naive testers independently reach a visible landmark with no minimap dependency.
No water fallthrough; the route edge is legible canals, hedges, walls, bridges and doors rather than an invisible barrier in camera view.
One Quill choice at an approved existing NPC placement - no new NPC system; one intent/flag transaction; movement returns on exit; no replay reward.
Warmth and a clear next-place cue, not a lore dump.
Walkable canal edge among pollarded ash with no forced swimming; the camera sees a clear destination and the house/village recall.
The musical ecology responds visibly but subtly, through the existing single-writer water/material/Niagara paths.
An existing trigger or Quill beat hands off to the approved First Dream continuation; no new quest IDs guessed, no invented checkpoint.
The transition target and persistence are explicitly confirmed by test, not assumed.
